mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment signals robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: The PAYEMS trend fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances across all market regimes.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index exceeds 240, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The CPIAUCSL threshold fails to predict negative returns (20-day returns positive in >50% of triggered instances).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payroll employment and housing starts indicates strong consumer demand and confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through joint demand effects.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs pressure corporate profits.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, the FEDFUNDS increase fails to predict negative returns (20-day returns positive in >50% of cases).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: The INDPRO trend fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances across all market regimes.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The UNRATE threshold fails to predict negative 60-day returns (returns positive in >50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through policy response effects.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer spending, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic momentum wanes.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, the RSAFS decline fails to predict negative returns (20-day returns positive in >50% of cases).
